history.architecture_16_resume: architecture 17. Architecture 16 refused, and its result is corpus-wide rather than local: the propagation shape (a change acting on a unit the data is not reported at, its effect carried through a cycle or cohort structure) is SPENT AS A DRIVER, being task125's. Proven four ways. The cheapest licensed route IS the golden: one join, one two-way group-by on (regime, position), one reweight reproduces the designed path at RMSE 0.0072 and max 0.0170 on the clean truth, 2.8 and 3.3 per cent of its level. The LINKAGE TRICHOTOMY makes that structural, not a generous register: the mixture weights must be shipped for the path to be computable and the position ships with them, so a row carries its cohort directly (one group-by), or a key a register maps (one join plus group-by, same cost), or nothing identifying the unit, in which case the profile is identifiable only from the published series, which is the quantity in question (a cubic with seasonal terms reproduces 90.5 per cent of the distortion path's variance). No fourth case. task125 shipped only because a TRUE operational sentence made the join look pointless, which is a device, and Part 6 licenses re-skinning a device and never a driver. And the guard refuses it: BLOCK on test.same_puzzle_older AND test.same_driver_older against task125 (v2), driver.near 0.19, nearest on file by three times against a next of 0.06, with task125's Lesson line stating the generalisation verbatim so a faithful instance fails its own Lesson test. The pass also confirmed the shape is genuinely NOT the closed multiplicative family (the correction is additive in cohort-position cells, the latent object is a profile over positions, and there is no candidate ranking, so no law has a term to bind). The forward-facing variant escapes the group-by but moves the decisive step onto a functional-form transport, which is architecture 1's fitted-counterfactual family, closed for this slot though its own separation rule is satisfied (663 to 1,417 against a likelihood ratio of 1.02 to 1), so reopening it is an author decision. TWO UNPRICED DIRECTIONS, neither a recommendation: the path's turning point graded instead of its levels (transports disagree 28, 32, 35, 35, 36 against a true 32, a discrete level-dependent object with a one-member standing family, but still task125's driver unless the propagation is not), and a structure whose position is NOT registered so the position is itself estimated, expected to die on the parametric horn with nothing on file measuring it.
